surface_name: Terraform provider v4 to v5 upgrade
title: Upgrading the Cloudflare Terraform provider to v5 breaks cloudflare_record and zone settings resources
symptoms: The provider cloudflare/cloudflare does not support resource type "cloudflare_record".
Old cloudflare_zone_settings_override blocks conflict with the v5 schema
Plans propose destroying and recreating DNS records
cause: v5 is a generated provider that renamed and restructured many resources, for example cloudflare_record became cloudflare_dns_record with content replacing value. A plain version bump leaves state and HCL on the old schema.
fix: Run tf-migrate in dry run, then apply its HCL rewrites and moved blocks, and follow the zone_settings_override removal steps on the v4 provider before switching.
apply:
go install github.com/cloudflare/tf-migrate/cmd/tf-migrate@latest
tf-migrate migrate --dry-run --source-version v4 --target-version v5
tf-migrate migrate --source-version v4 --target-version v5
